map.输入测得值与参考标准值，求绝对偏倚。: Enter the measured value and the reference standard value to get absolute bias.
map.：Bias=x−x_ref=20.35−20=0.350。正值说明测量值系统性偏: : Bias = x - x_ref = 20.35 - 20 = 0.350. A positive value means readings run systematically high, so subtract it from later readings when correcting.
map.：bias = mean(测量值) - 参考值（真值）。例：参考 10.000: : bias = mean(measured) - reference (true value). Example: with a reference of 10.000 mm and a 10-reading mean of 10.015, bias = +0.015 mm.
